chose: a stored remote.port with no remote.enabled key is kept and bound by the always-on remote listener; only a remote block whose enabled was not literally true loses its port, and the remote listener port file carries a per-process owner token and is withdrawn by the shutdown path
over: dropping every remote.port without an enabled key, or withdrawing the port file on the listener's close event
because: after this change a deliberately set remote.port has no enabled key either, so no stored shape tells an old off listener from an operator's chosen port; the close event can fire after a replacement server republished the same port, so only the owner token proves the file is this server's
binding: none: this session owns no active work order
